The model is capable of approximating light transmission, absorption, and interference behavior within the layered systems. Preliminary analysis validated that the optical transmission of ultra-thin Ag film alone is poor due to the reflection between the air/Ag interface. However, substantial improvement in optical transmission can be achieved with an added TCO layer. The model used spectral refractive indexes reported in the literature and predicted the optical transmission of the multi-layer system for varying combinations of IZO and Ag layer thicknesses. The predicted maximum transmission for an IZO/Ag multilayer structure was obtained with a 50nm-IZO/7nm-Ag simulated structure (Figure 11). The simulated results were corroborated experimentally with an IZO/Ag multilayer with approximate thicknesses of 50nm and 10 ± 3 nm, respectively. The multilayer measured averaged transmittance of 82.8% and peak transmittance of 90.3% in the 400-850nm wavelength range (Figure 11) pertinent to PSCs, and exhibited low sheet resistance (4.65 Ω/Sq.).
